comment: Live planner canary question set — freshly authored operational probes. ZERO overlap with evals/sql/cases.jsonl or any gold artifact. expected_outcome_class is a soft operational expectation (outcome type only, never a result value) — divergence is recorded, not failed, except where marked hard.

questions.q: How many customer orders are currently open?
Count of jobs per department for jobs started during July 2026.
List the invoices that are more than a month past their due date, with what is still owed on each.
